description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Compare 1 to 15 space companies side by side in a deterministic peer benchmark matrix: Space Score on the 0 to 1000 scale (with pillar scores and methodologyVersion), published private funding totals (USD disclosed total plus non-USD round count), USAspending.gov federal prime obligations, USAspending.gov SBIR/STTR space R&D grants, live FCC/FAA/NOAA regulatory filings and latest SEC EDGAR XBRL annual revenue preserving reported ISO currency.

slugs.description: 1 to 15 company profile slugs to benchmark side by side, e.g. ["rocket-lab", "planet-labs", "spacex"].

name: research_portfolio_benchmark
title: Portfolio peer benchmark matrix
